pages.title: About Me
pages.text: Zhongquan Zhou Computer Science Graduate Student @ Shanghai Jiao Tong University I am a master's student in Computer Science and Technology at Shanghai Jiao Tong University. My current interests include machine learning, embodied intelligence, multimodal biomedical data mining, and generative materials design. Email: zhouzhq2021@sjtu.edu.cn GitHub: zhouzhq2021 Location: Shanghai, China Education 2025.09 - 2028.03 Shanghai Jiao Tong University M.S. student, Computer Science and Technology. GPA: 3.70/4.0. 2021.09 - 2025.06 Lanzhou University B.S., Computer Science and Technology. GPA: 3.97/5.0. Research Experience 2025.02 - 2025.05 Adaptive Contrastive Optimization for Safe and Robust Robot Manipulation Proposed ACORN, an adaptive contrastive optimization algorithm for robust and safe embodied intelligence deployment. Used dual-perturbation contrastive learning to generate negative samples and align robot trajectories with expert demonstrations without manual annotation. Designed safety-centered metrics to quantify manipulation stability under extreme conditions. 2025.09 - 2025.12 Equivariant Machine Learning Force Fields and Generative Materials Design Studied diffusion models and flow matching for materials generation, with emphasis on energy-guided vector field optimization. Explored integrating three-body attention into equivariant frameworks for stronger representation of complex atomic systems. Investigated low-rank decomposition and related acceleration techniques for large-scale materials pretraining. Selected Projects 2023.03 - 2024.03 Multimodal Biomedical Pattern Mining for Disease Combination Medication Integrated multimodal drug data, including chemical structural groups, enzyme genes, and target genes. Formulated joint medication pattern mining as a machine learning classification problem. Built and deployed a Streamlit-based web system for remote access. 2024.02 - 2024.06 Intelligent Manhole Cover Hazard Recognition and Processing System Applied object detection to recognize manhole cover status automatically. Used diffusion-based image generation to mitigate sample imbalance. Developed the application with UniApp for hazard recognition and processing workflows. 2024.12 - 2025.03 Macrosomia Risk Prediction with Ensemble Learning Built an end-to-end risk prediction workflow based on ensemble learning. Designed a multi-method feature selection strategy and a Stacking ensemble architecture. Improved model generalization and stability for clinical risk prediction. Honors & Awards 2024.12 National Scholarship for Undergraduates, 2023-2024 2023.11 Lanzhou University-Huawei "Intelligent Foundation" Scholarship 2025.05 Outstanding Graduate of Gansu Province 2022.10 National First Prize, 5th China Open Source Innovation Competition 2023.11 National Second Prize, China Collegiate Computing Competition 2025.05 Honorable Mention, MCM/ICM 2025 Skills & Languages Python C++ PyTorch Machine Learning Contrastive Learning Diffusion Models Streamlit UniApp Linux CET-4: 565 CET-6: 520 Mandarin: Level 2-A

posts.title: About Me
posts.text: Hello, World! 👋 I’m Zhongquan Zhou, a Computer Science and Technology graduate student at Shanghai Jiao Tong University. My interests include machine learning, embodied intelligence, multimodal biomedical data mining, and software systems. 🎓 Education Shanghai Jiao Tong University (2025-2028) M.S. student in Computer Science and Technology GPA: 3.70/4.0 Lanzhou University (2021-2025) B.S. in Computer Science and Technology GPA: 3.97/5.0 💻 Technical Skills Programming Languages: Python, C++, JavaScript Machine Learning: PyTorch, ensemble learning, contrastive learning, diffusion models Systems & Tools: Linux, Git, Streamlit, UniApp Areas of Interest: Machine Learning Embodied Intelligence Biomedical Data Mining Generative Materials Design 🔬 Research Adaptive Contrastive Optimization for Safe and Robust Robot Manipulation: proposed ACORN, a plug-and-play contrastive optimization method for aligning robot trajectories with expert demonstrations under safety and robustness challenges. Equivariant Machine Learning Force Fields and Generative Materials Design: explored diffusion models, flow matching, three-body attention, spherical harmonic convolution, and acceleration techniques for large-scale materials datasets. 🌟 Selected Projects Multimodal Biomedical Pattern Mining for Disease Combination Medication: modeled joint medication pattern mining as a machine learning classification problem and built a Streamlit-based web system. Intelligent Manhole Cover Hazard Recognition and Processing System: applied object detection and diffusion-based image generation to improve recognition under imbalanced samples, with a UniApp-based application. Macrosomia Risk Prediction with Ensemble Learning: designed a feature selection strategy and Stacking ensemble architecture to improve model generalization and stability. 🏆 Honors National Scholarship for Undergraduates, 2023-2024 Lanzhou University-Huawei “Intelligent Foundation” Scholarship Outstanding Graduate of Gansu Province National First Prize, 5th China Open Source Innovation Competition National Second Prize, China Collegiate Computing Competition Honorable Mention, MCM/ICM 2025 📫 Contact Me Email: zhouzhq2021@sjtu.edu.cn GitHub: zhouzhq2021 Location: Shanghai, China Feel free to reach out if you’d like to collaborate on projects or just chat about technology!
